nodes_changed.qualified_name: test_the_addon_suites_run_after_the_single_build
nodes_changed.doc:
The consumers' addon suites make the binary loadable with ensure-addon.sh,
which builds when none loads. In one `moon run` beside the rpc-access
build-addon, moon runs them in parallel and two napi builds race on one
target dir and one .node; the task runs the build first and each consumer
after it, one `moon run` per line.
